rundown: Wolfpack beat Phoenix 96-72 at Lenovo Center in Raleigh, NC. Wolfpack led 46-38 at half-time and never looked back. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 92%).
Leading the way — Phoenix: Randall Pettus II 28 pts; Raúl Villar 6 ast; Josh Dalton 5 reb. Wolfpack: Paul McNeil Jr. 31 pts, 5 ast; Kyle Evans 7 reb.
Where Wolfpack won it: they shot 63% to 42%, shot 53% from three to 41% and won the boards 33-21.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Wolfpack closed as 19.5-point favorites and covered by 4.5; the total closed at 149.5 and they combined for 168, over by 18.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 28, 11:57 AM ET. It had Phoenix 5% and Wolfpack 95%, projecting Phoenix 66.4 – Wolfpack 84.2 (150.6 total, Wolfpack by 17.9).

Final: Phoenix 72 – Wolfpack 96. Right winner: it had Wolfpack at 95%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Phoenix came in with a 3% below average attack and a league-average defense (3-4, 70.6 scored and 72.1 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 199 and 199 games of evidence. Projected to score 66.4, they scored 72 (+5.6 points, 9% over); projected to allow 84.2, they allowed 96 (+11.8 points, 14% over).

Wolfpack came in with a 10% above average attack and a 6% stingier than average defense (6-1, 84.1 scored and 66.9 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 199 and 198 games of evidence. Projected to score 84.2, they scored 96 (+11.8 points, 14% over); projected to allow 66.4, they allowed 72 (+5.6 points, 9% over).

The bigger miss was Wolfpack's scoring (+11.8 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 168 against 150.6 projected (+17.4), about the 88th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Wolfpack by 24 against Wolfpack by 17.9 projected, about the 71st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Wolfpack ×1.00, Phoenix ×1.02. It favored Phoenix, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
NCSU ML (-4000) at -4000: the algo gave it 94% vs 94% fair (+0 pts) — won (+0u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 94%). ELON ML (+1600) at +1600: the algo gave it 6% vs 6% fair (0 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 6%). NCSU -19.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.3 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. ELON +19.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 149.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.2 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 149.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 44% of bets on Phoenix, 50% of the money — Wolfpack covered; total: 63% of bets on the over, 62% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 5% of bets on Phoenix, 0% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Phoenix, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.089 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +7.2 points. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1252 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.977 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Phoenix attack ×0.978, defense ×0.983 (7 games); Wolfpack attack ×1.007, defense ×0.990 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
